content: Our datasets are scientific articles that were published on arXiv. The sets contain articles (in LaTeX format) from four computer science domains: NLP, IR, AI, and ML. They were created by filtering arXiv articles based on their primary and secondary categories. We used the following categories for the four collections: cs.cl for NLP; cs.ir for IR; cs.ai for AI and stat.ml, stat.co, stat.me or cs.lg for ML.
